reset_window.title: Abandon our Empire?
reset_window.message: Are you sure you want to leave your empire? Everything you have achieved will be lost forever!

info.city_message:
Provides space for <norm>{city_space} people</norm>.
 Conquered city takes <norm>{city_repair} months</norm> to repair.
info.might_message: Total military might of our empire.
info.morale_message: Low morale will drive our people to rebel and flee the realm, while high morale will cause our numbers to flourish.
info.readiness_message: Our armies can attack once per month. After that, they become exhausted.
info.missing_space: We do not have enough space.

city_center_tooltip.message: Upgrade the city center to expand your capital and unlock new buildings and bonuses.

population_tooltip.title: Population
population_tooltip.no_space_message: <high>Our dwellings are full. Build more or conquer new land.</high>
population_tooltip.exceeded_space_message: <neg>Housing capacity exceeded. People are abandoning the realm.</neg>

card_abandon_empire.title: Abandon Empire
card_abandon_empire.message: Leave our people behind and found a new empire.

card_taxes.title: Taxes
card_taxes.flavor_text: We can raise or lower the taxes upon our people, though it will heavily influence their morale.
card_taxes.effect_lenient: Lowers taxes by <neg>{tax}%</neg>. Rises morale by <pos>{morale}%</pos>.
card_taxes.effect_oppressive: Rises taxes by <pos>{tax}%</pos>. Reduces morale by <neg>{morale}%</neg>.

card_rations.title: Rations
card_rations.flavor_text: We can adjust the monthly food rations of our people, which will directly influence their morale and the growth rate of the realm.
card_rations.effect_meager: Each ration sustains <pos>{food}</pos> citizens. Reduces population growth by <neg>{people}%</neg> and morale by <neg>{morale}%</neg>.
card_rations.effect_bountiful: Each ration sustains <neg>{food}</neg> citizens. Rises population growth by <pos>{people}%</pos> and morale by <pos>{morale}%</pos>.

card_production.title: Production
card_production.flavor_text: Adjust production across our farms, lumberyards and quarries. Grueling labor increases output, but drains food and lowers morale.
card_production.effect_restrained: Lessens production by <neg>{production}%</neg>. Reduces ration demands by <pos>{food}%</pos> and rises morale by <pos>{morale}%</pos>.
card_production.effect_grueling: Inceases production by <pos>{production}%</pos>. Rises ration demands by <neg>{food}%</neg> and reduces morale by <neg>{morale}%</neg>.

tavern.name: Tavern
tavern.description: A bustling hearth where weary travelers trade rumors of uncharted lands and offer the realm new quests.

card_report.title: The Empire's Report
card_report.report_population_full: <high>Our settlements are full. Construct more dwellings or expand our borders.</high>
card_report.report_food_decline: <high>Ration demands exceed our realm's monthly yield. Construct more farms.</high>
card_report.report_food_low: <neg>Our food stores are running dangerously low! Secure more grain, or the realm will plunge into famine.</neg>
card_report.report_overpopulation: <neg>Settlements have exceeded their limit. Having nowhere to dwell, </neg><purple>{lost}</purple>{icon_population} <neg>deserted the realm.</neg>
card_report.report_famine: <neg>Our people are starving! </neg><purple>{deaths}</purple>{icon_population} <neg>people died and</neg> <purple>{lost}</purple>{icon_population} <neg>deserted the realm. The deserters are spreading ill news about our empire. We lost</neg>{fame}{icon_fame}.

card_scouts.title: Scout Missives
card_scouts.default_message: Our scouts have returned empty handed.

instant.gold_early_a: A scout uncovered a small stash buried beneath a withered tree. It contained <gold>{amount}</gold> {icon_gold}.
instant.gold_early_b: Our scouts found an abandoned camp and recovered a small chest containing <gold>{amount}</gold> {icon_gold}.
instant.gold_early_c: While clearing out the undergrowth, a laborer found a weathered pouch containing <gold>{amount}</gold> {icon_gold}.
instant.food_early_a: Our scouts discovered an old farmstead and scavenged <food>{amount}</food> {icon_food}.
instant.food_early_b: Our outriders found a deserted camp, recovering <food>{amount}</food> {icon_food} left behind.
instant.food_early_c: Our scouts discovered a wild orchard and harvested <food>{amount}</food> {icon_food}.
instant.wood_early_a: Our scouts discovered an old lumberyard and scavenged <wood>{amount}</wood> {icon_wood}.
instant.wood_early_b: Our scouts surveyed a ruined settlement and salvaged <wood>{amount}</wood> {icon_wood}.
instant.wood_early_c: Our outriders found an abandoned logging camp, securing <wood>{amount}</wood> {icon_wood} left behind.
instant.stone_early_a: Our laborers surveyed a ruined village and salvaged <stone>{amount}</stone> {icon_stone}.
instant.stone_early_b: Our scouts surveyed a forgotten quarry and salvaged <stone>{amount}</stone> {icon_stone}.
instant.fertile_land: Our scouts have surveyed fertile ground, ripe for the plow. A new <food>farm</food> may now be built.
instant.lush_forest: Our scouts discovered dense woodland. A new <wood>lumberyard</wood> may now be built.
instant.stone_deposit: Our scouts surveyed a rugged stone deposit. A new <stone>quarry</stone> may now be built.

ongoing.bountiful_harvest: <gb>BOUNTIFUL HARVEST!</gb> Thanks to the favourable weather, our <food>farms</food> production is doubled <italic>({duration} month(s) left)</italic>.
ongoing.drought: <rb>DROUGHT!</rb> Our realm is suffering from severe drought. Our <food>farms</food> yield no harvest. <italic>({duration} month(s) left)</italic>.

errors.upgrade_failed_message: We cannot upgrade our capital at this time.
errors.progress_turn_failed_message: A dark magic disrupted the realm. Your turn could not be completed.
errors.max_level_reached: Capital is already at the max level.
